Item health card

Source: R/item_card.R
item_card.Rd

A one-page visual summary of a single item for item review meetings: trace curves, information, observed versus expected scores, the response distribution and a key-statistics panel with a traffic-light status.

Usage

item_card(x, item, alpha = 0.01, tab = NULL)

Arguments

x

a unidimensional model from mirt::mirt().

item

a single item, by position or name.

alpha

significance level for item misfit.

tab

optional precomputed item_table() (saves time when making many cards).

Value

A patchwork object.

Details

Status rules: red for misfit, low discrimination (a < 0.5) or an item-total correlation below .10; amber for any other flag (see item_table()); green otherwise.

Examples

mod <- mirt(Science, 1, verbose = FALSE)
item_card(mod, "Work")
